references.text: David asks his servants to keep their distance, which mirrors Peter's actions in following Jesus at a distance.
This passage describes Peter's denial of Jesus, which occurs after he followed Jesus to the high priest's courtyard.
Mark's version of Peter following at a distance to the high priest's courtyard.
Luke's description of how Peter followed Jesus to the high priest's house.
John gives a detailed account of how Peter and another disciple followed Jesus to the high priest's courtyard.
